items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: The name 'Mahajie' is mentioned only by the [INTERVIEWER] in a hypothetical context ('Let me call you Sweetheart and Mahajie, man'). The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to the name or confirm any personal relationship.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. I had a clown costume to start off with. Uh-huh. Because I, uh, I was the kind of imitating, I got the idea from the Six Brown Brothers. You remember the old Six Brown Brothers? Yeah. Used to wear clown costumes, playing saxophone. They had a saxophone sextet they did. Yeah. Uh, that was one of my uniforms. That was starting. Then I used to sing romantic songs, you know. I had a fair voice too. You mean straight or?

Straight. Let me call you Sweetheart and Mahajie, man. I'd take off good on those numbers. Yeah? What did the other guys, what kind of a guy did you have? We had comedians, we, well it was a variety show. And how many musicians in there? Uh, that, uh, about four or five, all of you, we never had no straight comedians. Uh-huh. Everybody was doubling. Everybody had a doubling. Musicians had a double. What instruments? Them cats had to do everything.
